pool.glaive_dedup: one schema per original function name (filename minus 8-hex suffix): lowest rank key

review_rules.process: Candidates reviewed strictly in pool_candidates.jsonl rank order; first 300 accepted form the pool. Every reviewed candidate gets a recorded decision.
accept_if: purpose is interpretable from the schema itself (title/description/property names) without guessing
at least one top-level property whose value a user could state in natural language

reject_codes.OPAQUE: purpose not interpretable from the schema
reject_codes.NO_USER_VALUES: no property a user could plausibly supply (only internal/system fields)
reject_codes.SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE: same purpose and near-same inputs as an already-accepted tool
reject_codes.PII: schema embeds apparent personal data (real-looking emails, credentials) - excluded from prompts

metadata_style.tool_name: snake_case verb_object, unique, no dataset/subset/schema identifiers; GlaiveAI tools keep their original function name
metadata_style.description: one sentence, <= 25 words, states what the tool does; written once, identical in every representation
metadata_style.family: short label of the tool's function; a catalog contains at most one tool per family
metadata_style.task_suitable: true if a natural-language request can fully determine values for all required fields (used only for target eligibility)

catalogs.construction: per replicate: 5 targets (strata alternate 3/2 and 2/3 across replicates; targets disjoint across replicates; drawn from task_suitable tools) + 95 distractors; at most one tool per family; distractors ordered by greedy stratum balancing so every prefix is balanced; Catalog_k = first k tools (nested); presentation order = seeded shuffle per (replicate,size), identical across representations
